verdict.rationale: Formant's documented capabilities cover onboarding an already-working robot to its cloud platform rather than hardware bring-up itself. It offers a Docker-based agent install for ROS 2 devices, claims to connect multiple robot types "with minimal lift," lets you configure devices, and provides teleoperation that could drive a first remote motion. Missing for 10: any driver or hardware-integration tooling, robot motion configuration (e.g., kinematics or controllers), evidence of an hours-not-weeks bring-up timeline, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
